title: Think our educational research dollars should also focus more on people rather than p values. #GearUpNH changed lives. That is only effect size I need
summary: Think our educational research dollars should also focus more on people rather than p values. #GearUpNH changed lives. That is only effect size I need. Let's use educational research dollars to invest and celebrate local knowledge not impose interventions.
